integrity: No borrowed full-text paper is included. The mathematical statement is supported by an explicit case-partition proof and a separately executable finite checker. Novelty remains subject to residual unindexed-literature risk.
scientific_limitations: Exact polynomial restricted to positive five-run binary words; only asymptotic maximum and limiting rigidity are proved, not exact finite-n maximizers or the optimal second term. Computer checks are finite and independent human verification is not claimed.
title: Scattered palindrome spectrum and sharp cubic growth for five-run binary words
